head: Siri AI no longer needs a waitlist on iOS 27
dek: Apple's support page now says turning on Siri AI starts the download right away; a waitlist is used only at times of high demand. Before, everyone joined a waitlist first.
details: You switch it on with "Try Siri AI (Beta)" in Settings.
where: iPhones that support Siri AI on iOS 27
means: If you haven't tried Siri AI yet, you should get it straight away in most cases.
todo: Open Settings, tap "Try Siri AI (Beta)" and wait for the download.
